import heapq
import sys

def compute_best(arr):
    top = []   # min-heap (top half)
    bot = []   # max-heap negated (bottom half)
    top_sum = 0
    bot_sum = 0
    n = len(arr)
    best = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    for i, x in enumerate(arr):
        if not top or x >= top[0]:
            heapq.heappush(top, x)
            top_sum += x
        else:
            heapq.heappush(bot, -x)
            bot_sum += x
        
        # rebalance: keep |top| - |bot| in {0, 1}
        while len(top) > len(bot) + 1:
            v = heapq.heappop(top)
            top_sum -= v
            heapq.heappush(bot, -v)
            bot_sum += v
        while len(bot) > len(top):
            v = -heapq.heappop(bot)
            bot_sum -= v
            heapq.heappush(top, v)
            top_sum += v
        
        k = i + 1
        if k % 2 == 0:
            best[k] = top_sum - bot_sum
    
    return best

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    A = list(map(int, data[1:N+1]))
    
    if N % 2 == 0:
        s = sorted(A)
        half = N // 2
        print(sum(s[half:]) - sum(s[:half]))
    else:
        prefBest = compute_best(A)
        sufBest = compute_best(A[::-1])
        ans = 0
        for p in range(1, N + 1, 2):
            left_len = p - 1
            right_len = N - p
            v = prefBest[left_len] + sufBest[right_len]
            if v > ans:
                ans = v
        print(ans)

main()
